title: 第68章珍宝楼的邀请第67章 眼睛
slug: 莫欺老年穷一天增加一个天赋点
lines: 鹰钩鼻男子脸上的笑容瞬间凝固，取而代之的是一片狰狞的戾气。
“找死！”
一声厉喝，他脚下青石板轰然碎裂，整个人如炮弹般射出，一爪抓向陈安的咽喉！
身后两名探子也同时暴起，一左一右，抽刀斩向陈安的双腿，配合得天衣无缝！
三人的脸上，都带着残忍的笑意。
然而，下一刻，他们脸上的笑容，永远定格。
在他们眼中，那个本该被瞬间撕碎的陈安，身影竟如青烟般，凭空消失在了原地。
不好！
鹰钩鼻男子心中警铃大作，一股致命的寒意从尾椎骨直冲天灵盖！
他想也不想，便要强行收招回防。
可一切，都太迟了。
“咔嚓！咔嚓！”
两声清脆得令人牙酸的骨裂声，几乎同时从他身后响起。
他骇然回头，看到的，是自己两名同伴的身体，正以一个诡异的姿势软软倒下，脑袋无力地耷拉着，颈骨已被一股无可抗拒的巨力，干净利落地捏成了齑粉！
而那个黑袍文士，不知何时，已如鬼魅般出现在他们身后。
鹰钩鼻男子瞳孔收缩到极致，肝胆俱裂，浑身的护体气血疯狂催动！
他看到的，是一只放大的拳头。
那拳头之上，泛着一层厚重深沉的古铜色光泽，没有丝毫气血光华，却带着一种足以碾碎山岳的纯粹力量感，后发先至，瞬间击溃了他引以为傲的护体气血！
一声闷响。
拳头重重地印在了他的胸膛。
鹰钩鼻男子僵在原地，缓缓低头。
他难以置信地看着自己整个胸口，竟深深地塌陷下去，形成一个恐怖的拳印，连带着后面的脊骨，都已寸寸断裂。
生机，如潮水般迅速退去。
他张了张嘴，只来得及吐出一个字，便轰然倒地，气绝身亡。
从出手到结束，不过一息。
陈安面无表情地甩了甩手，仿佛只是拍死了三只苍蝇。
他弯腰熟练地将三具尸体上的碎银摸索一空，然后一手一个，如同扔麻袋般，将他们尽数扔进了废弃院落那口深不见底的枯井之中。
做完这一切，他拾起地上的包裹，甩在肩上，正准备离去。
突然，陈安的脚步猛然一顿。
他那经过炼脏圆满淬炼的敏锐感知，清晰地捕捉到了巷口处两道微不可察的气息。
这两道气息与方才那三个废物截然不同，这两道收敛得极好，如同融入阴影的磐石，若非他感知力惊人，几乎无法察觉。
又有人？
陈安缓缓将肩上的包裹放下，他的面容上，浮现出一抹冰冷。
content_en:
The smile on the hook-nosed man's face instantly froze, replaced by a ferocious look of hostility.
"Seeking death!"
With a sharp shout, the bluestone beneath his feet shattered, and his whole body shot out like a cannonball, grabbing Chen An's throat with one claw!
The two spies behind him also jumped up at the same time. One on the left and one on the right, they slashed at Chen An's legs with their swords. They cooperated perfectly!
All three of them had cruel smiles on their faces.
However, the next moment, the smiles on their faces were frozen forever.
In their eyes, Chen An, who should have been torn to pieces in an instant, disappeared into thin air like smoke.
not good!
The hook-nosed man's heart rang with alarm, and a deadly chill shot from his tailbone to the sky!
Without even thinking about it, he had to forcefully withdraw his troops and return to defense.
But everything is too late.
"Crack! Click!"
Two bone-breaking sounds, so clear and heartbreaking, sounded from behind him almost at the same time.
He turned around in shock, and what he saw was the bodies of his two companions, falling softly in a strange posture, their heads hanging weakly, and their neck bones had been neatly crushed into powder by an irresistible force!
And the black-robed scribe, at some point, appeared behind them like a ghost.
The hook-nosed man's pupils shrank to the extreme, his liver and gallbladder were torn apart, and the protective energy and blood all over his body were activated crazily!
What he saw was an enlarged fist.
There was a thick and deep bronze sheen on the fist, without any brilliance of Qi and blood, but with a sense of pure power that could crush mountains. It struck first and instantly defeated the body-protecting Qi and blood that he was proud of!
"Bang!"
There was a muffled sound.
The fist hit his chest hard.
The hook-nosed man froze in place and slowly lowered his head.
He watched in disbelief as his entire chest collapsed deeply, forming a terrifying fist mark, and even the spine behind it was broken inch by inch.
The vitality receded quickly like the tide.
"You..."
He opened his mouth, but only had time to spit out one word before he fell to the ground and died.
From the start to the end, it only takes one breath.
Chen An waved his hand expressionlessly, as if he had just swatted three flies to death.
He bent down and skillfully groped for all the broken silver from the three corpses, and then threw them all into the bottomless dry well in the abandoned courtyard, one by one, like throwing sacks.
After doing all this, he picked up the package on the ground, threw it on his shoulder, and was about to leave.
Suddenly, Chen An's footsteps stopped suddenly.
His keen perception, which had been perfectly tempered by refining the viscera, clearly captured the two imperceptible breaths at the entrance of the alley.
These two auras are completely different from the three wastes just now. These two auras are extremely convergent, like a rock blending into the shadow. If it weren't for his amazing perception, it would be almost impossible to detect it.
Is there anyone else?
Chen An slowly put down the package on his shoulders, and a touch of coldness appeared on his face.
